name_en: Exercise 17: uniqueness and continuous dependence for the critical nonlinear Schrödinger equation
description: For λ=(d+4)/d and q=(2d+4)/d, prove uniqueness of strong solutions with the same initial data and local Lipschitz dependence on nearby L2 initial data by subdividing time and reusing the contraction estimate from Theorem 6.9.

name_en: Exercise 18: L2 identity and inversion formula for the bilinear Radon transform in odd dimension
description: For nondegenerate bilinear B in odd dimension, establish the fractional x_d-derivative L2 identity, identify the formal adjoint, and deduce the inversion formula for R_B.

description: For R_B' = η'R_B(ηf), prove L2 boundedness, commute general derivatives into x_d-derivatives plus cutoff terms, and deduce boundedness L2→L2_{(d-1)/2}.

name_en: Problem 2*: the spherical maximal function
description: For spherical averages A_t, state and motivate the maximal estimate ||A* f||_p≤c_p||f||_p when p>d/(d-1), including the local p=2 argument in d≥3 using a t-derivative estimate.

description: For the wave equation with u(x,0)=0 and ∂_t u(x,0)=f, the problem states almost-everywhere convergence u(x,t)/t→f(x) for f∈Lp with p>2d/(d+1).

name_en: Problem 4*: the full restriction range in dimension two
description: Show the restriction phenomenon in R2 for 1≤p<4/3 by duality and the absolute continuity/Lr estimate for ν*ν, followed by Hausdorff-Young.

description: For wave evolution with zero displacement and initial velocity f, establish the spacetime estimate with q=(2d+2)/(d-2), d≥3.

description: Collect the Hardy series representation, mean-square asymptotic, unbounded normalized limsup, and improved exponent results for E(R)=N(R)-πR^2, including α=131/208.
